feature: Share the compiled object-spread helper across classic entry modules
scope: The classic linker already removes repeated TypeScript __awaiter and __generator initializations. Object spread emits the same kind of per-module __assign fallback, and the linker did not recognize it, so ten identical copies of one helper shipped inside the entry. The linker now accepts __assign and derives its signature from compiler output that includes object spread. No source module, runtime behavior, budget or asset cap changes.

source.identityMode: Unstamped local npm run build for both artifacts; the same commit, toolchain and optimizer, with only the linker change between them.

helperOccurrences.name: __assign
helperOccurrences.method: Counted emitted helper statements in the classic entry modules and measured the source text of each block.
helperOccurrences.keptDefinition: The first initialization stays in its original position, so preceding code and a pre-existing global helper observe the same execution order.

startupCost.method: Isolated evaluation of the emitted initializer block, 300000 iterations after warmup.
startupCost.claim: Nine duplicate top-level initializations are gone. The measured cost is about 0.25 microseconds, so this change is a payload reduction and is not claimed as a runtime speedup.

releaseEnvelopeEntryAfter.method: node scripts/check-release-envelope-size.cjs with the release version suffix and revision stamp.

validation: tests/test_classic_linker.cjs now links two object-spread modules and asserts one __assign definition, plus the merged result of each module; it still covers __awaiter and __generator, dynamic-code fallbacks, conflicting helpers and already-linked input.
tests/test_classic_size.cjs, tests/test_classic_size_diagnostics.cjs, tests/test_classic_optimizer.cjs, node scripts/check-es5.cjs and node scripts/check-release-envelope-size.cjs pass.

Runtime suites that exercise the affected modules pass: tests/test_settings_store.cjs, tests/test_command_server.cjs, tests/test_remote_controls.cjs, tests/test_kiosk.cjs, tests/test_channel_library_lifecycle.cjs, tests/test_remote_requests.cjs.
unchangedGuards: Every provider and optional asset cap, and the provider, optional and compatibility inventories
Legacy, base and complete payload caps
Private classic modules keep their own helper scope; the pass still receives only shared modules
Existing historical receipts and the fixed identity headroom
limitations: Payload and helper-count measurements only. No end-to-end startup benchmark was run, because the entry needs a DOM to execute.
The remaining identical-function duplication in the entry is 1358 bytes across small closures; it was left alone because each merge would change module boundaries for a marginal gain.
